name: Algolia

images.title: Your catalog in Algolia
images.description: Push every active product to your Algolia index from Products → Algolia sync and follow the progress.

images.title: Product changes sync on their own
images.description: Create, edit, deactivate or delete a product in Swell, and Algolia is updated within moments.

images.title: Sync everything or just what's new
images.description: Sync all products or only those created since a date. Stop at any time and resume from the next page.

images.title: Connected in a few minutes
images.description: Paste your Algolia Application ID and Admin API Key and choose the index. Automatic updates are on by default.
